description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the ImageController in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It contains setup methods, data providers, and test cases to verify image handling functionality such as content type, cache control, ETag validation, and response content.

classes.name: ImageControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ImageController responsible for image response handling in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test data before any tests run by loading a Theme YAML fixture.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Tests the handle method of ImageController for various image names. Verifies content-type, cache headers, ETag handling, and response content.

methods.name: dataProviderForController
methods.description: Provides test data sets with image names, expected sizes, and ETags for use in the testHandle method.
